name: Laibery
description: Runtime utility CSS generated from class names. Every class token contains $, for example b$2$s$red -> border: 2px solid red.

install.note: Load one JavaScript file. It scans the DOM and observes changes. No build step and no separate CSS file.

override.mechanism: Generated declarations use !important and the generated stylesheet is kept last in the document.
caveats: A site inline style with !important wins.
A site !important rule with higher specificity wins.
Cascade layers with !important should be tested.

variants.dark: dark: targets descendants of an element with class="dark"

values.result: Bare numbers become px for length properties.
Percentages. pct avoids % in class names.
#ff0000. Hex with or without #; 3, 4, 6 or 8 digits.
var(--lb-primary). Palette names become theme variables.
URLs work because the parser splits at the first $.

curated.note: Display aliases: f flex, g grid, b block, ib inline-block, i inline, n none, if inline-flex, ig inline-grid, t table, tc table-cell, li list-item, c contents, fr flow-root.
relative, absolute, fixed, sticky and other CSS keywords.
Bare numbers become px.
Laibery uses z for z-index. The map uses z for zoom, which is available as zoom$1.5.
Separate the two sides with $.
r row, c column, rr row-reverse, cr column-reverse. Full words also work.
wrap, nowrap, wrap-reverse.
Accepts one or two values: gap$8$16.
cols$3 becomes repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)).
full, screen, fit, min, max, percentages and CSS lengths.
p accepts 1–4 values like the CSS shorthand. px/py set both sides.
Negative values work: m$-8. mx$auto centers a block.
Weight aliases: thin 100, extralight 200, light 300, normal/n 400, medium/m 500, semibold/sb 600, bold/b 700, extrabold/eb 800, black 900.
sans, serif and mono map to theme font stacks.
1.5 stays unitless; 24 becomes 24px.
u underline, n none, l line-through.
Values are classified by type: width, style, then color. Visible borders need a style.
br is border-right. Use r for border-radius.
r$full becomes 9999px. r$8$8$0$0 accepts four corners.
Integers are percentages: 50 becomes 0.5.
sm, md, lg and xl map to theme shadow variables.
tr$300$inout sets duration and timing.

extras.note: SVG path data. The map alias d is used by Laibery for display.
SVG radius. The map alias r is used by Laibery for border-radius.

api: Scan the document and observe changes. Idempotent.
Register tokens immediately, even if they are not in the DOM.
Return the CSS for one token, or null if invalid.
Update palette colors and re-render variables.
Read or set important and nonce.
limitations: Values cannot contain spaces. Use aliases or functions without spaces (calc(100%/3) works; calc(100% - 3px) does not).
Runtime only: there is no static extraction, SSR stylesheet or build-time purging.
JavaScript is required; the page has no styles until Laibery runs.
Override relies on !important plus stylesheet order. A site inline style with !important still wins; a site !important rule with higher specificity also wins.
Shadow DOM is not scanned; only the main document is observed.
Rules accumulate until reload; there is no automatic cleanup for tokens no longer in the DOM.
dark: is class-based (.dark ancestor), not prefers-color-scheme.
Variants cover pseudo-classes, breakpoints and dark:; there are no @supports or container-query variants yet.
